description: Welcome to The Parisian Loft — a unique Paris stay• Private pool… in ParisA rare indoor pool, almost unheard of in the city.• Eiffel-structure loftIconic metal design with glass ceilings.• 7m ceilings & exceptional volumesA spectacular, light-filled living space. AC.• Jungle atmosphereLush plants create an immersive escape.• Private entranceFeels like your own home.• 4 elegant suitesComfort, privacy and restful nights.• Authentic ParisEnjoy Paris & Disneyland —35 min away.The spaceLuxury Loft with Private Pool • Eiffel Structure • Full AC • Rare Paris ExperienceWelcome to The Parisian Loft — a rare, design-led private residence in Paris, consistently rated 5★ by guests.A spectacular 250m² Eiffel-structure loft with soaring glass ceilings, exceptional volumes and a unique jungle-inspired atmosphere. A place where architecture, light and nature create an unforgettable experience.⸻Private PoolEnjoy your own indoor pool — an extremely rare feature in Paris, offering a hotel-level experience with the privacy of a private home.Space & VolumeImpressive 7m ceilings create a breathtaking open space filled with natural light.Jungle AtmosphereLush plants bring a true sense of escape, far from the city.ComfortFully air-conditioned (2026 upgrade) for optimal comfort in every season.Privacy & AccessSemi-private entrance ensuring a high level of discretion and confidentiality, with the feeling of stepping into your own private residence.⸻SleepingDesigned for up to 8 guests:Master suite with king size bed (180 cm)Two guest suites with queen size beds (160 cm)Guest bedroom with sofa bed (140 cm)⸻Living & KitchenFully equipped high-end kitchen, large dining table, spacious living area, premium sofa and large Smart TV.⸻BathroomsMaster bathroom with bathtub and double sinksShower bathroom
